[[AS Saint-Etienne]] won the '''1973–74''' edition of the [[Ligue de Football Professionnel|French Association Football League]] Division 1 season with 66 points.

* [[Lille Olympique Sporting Club Lille Métropole|Lille]]: Champion of [[Ligue 2|Division 2]], winner of [[Ligue 2|Division 2]] group A
* [[Red Star Paris]]: Runner-up, winner of [[Ligue 2|Division 2]] group B
* [[Paris Saint-Germain|Paris Saint-Germain FC]]: Third place, winner of barrages
